subject: english
question:
**Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. It is a very popular character and is the mascot for Walt Disney company.

B. Mickey generally appears with his girlfriend Minnie Mouse and pet Pluto.

C. The animated movies on Mickey mouse have been nominated for the Academy award.

D.Mickey mouse is a fictional cartoon character created by Walt Disney in 1928.
solution:
The correct answer is "**DABC**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given stanza is talking about the** Mickey mouse cartoon **created by Disney so, the** first sentence** must be the **introductory sentence** of that cartoon.
 
• **Sentence D**, that is, *'Mickey mouse is a fictional cartoon character created by Walt Disney in 1928'* is **introducing the cartoon** and telling us when it started. Thus, it is the **first sentence.**
 
• **Sentence A**, that is, '*It is a very popular character and is the mascot for Walt Disney company*' is **mentioning the popularity of the cartoon**. So, this will be the **second sentence.**
 
• **Sentence B**, that is, '*Mickey generally appears with his girlfriend Minnie Mouse and pet Pluto*' is **continuing the story of Mickey **mouse. That is why this will be the **third sentence.**
 
• **Sentence C**, that is, '*The animated movies on Mickey mouse have been nominated for the Academy award'* is the **conclusive sentence** and the remaining one. Thus, this will be** the last sentence.**
 
• Hence, the correct answer is: *DABC*
